The exit HTF temperature is greater than 205 oC during the 14 hours of discharge operation. The HTF exit temperature of > 205 oC was targeted in M-2.6.1 to demonstrate that industrial process heat demands up to 200 oC can be realized using sulfur TES. Mechanical Factor of Safety: Using the temperature measured by the thermocouples, the thermal stress on the wall of the tank was calculated. The axial temperature gradient was found to be orders of magnitude smaller than the radial temperature gradient, making its contribution to thermal stresses negligible. In addition, the tank was allowed to expand freely in the axial direction due to the sliding saddle construction with slotted holes.
